secrets.name: TOKEN
secrets.description: Discord bot token (Developer Portal → Bot → Reset Token). Required at boot.

secrets.name: CLIENT_ID
secrets.description: Discord application (client) id, used for slash command registration and the invite URL.

secrets.name: GUILD_ID
secrets.description: Id of the Discord server the bot registers its slash commands in and operates in.

notes: Message Content Intent must be enabled in the Discord Developer Portal (Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents) or client.login() fails with 'Used disallowed intents'.
Runtime state (faq-data.json, faq-config.json) lives in the bot-data volume, not in the repo.
